defense_news.title: Popular military air show permanently pulled from RAF Fairford after suspected terror threat
defense_news.summary: Over a month after a suspected Iranian plot on RAF Fairford, organizers of the world's largest military air show announced its permanent departure to MOD Boscombe Down.

defense_news.title: Germany names Army Chief Freuding as next chief of defense
defense_news.summary: German Army Chief Christian Freuding will succeed Carsten Breuer to become the country's next chief of defense in February 2027.
